question: Can you identify the hubs that saw more than a 20% increase in finished orders from February to March?
sql:
WITH feb_orders AS (
  SELECT s.hub_id, COUNT(*) AS feb_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
    AND o.order_created_month = 2
    AND o.order_created_year = 2021
  GROUP BY s.hub_id
),
mar_orders AS (
  SELECT s.hub_id, COUNT(*) AS mar_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
    AND o.order_created_month = 3
    AND o.order_created_year = 2021
  GROUP BY s.hub_id
)
SELECT 
  h.hub_id,
  h.hub_name,
  feb_orders.feb_count,
  mar_orders.mar_count,
  CASE 
    WHEN feb_orders.feb_count = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE 1.0 * (mar_orders.mar_count - feb_orders.feb_count) / feb_orders.feb_count
  END AS pct_increase
FROM feb_orders
JOIN mar_orders ON feb_orders.hub_id = mar_orders.hub_id
JOIN hubs h ON feb_orders.hub_id = h.hub_id
WHERE CASE 
    WHEN feb_orders.feb_count = 0 THEN FALSE
    ELSE 1.0 * (mar_orders.mar_count - feb_orders.feb_count) / feb_orders.feb_count > 0.20
  END
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC
